measured_values_reason: Null by seed/contract.yaml's own convention: every quantity recorded null is measured at Phase 1 build time on the grading host and never authored at Phase 0. Authoring a floor, knee or ablation worth here would invent a measurement the bytes have not earned.
why_the_measured_anchors_do_not_yield_th: this record carries eight-seed starter and reference distributions, so it looks as though the ramp could be closed here. It cannot. The four null constants are grading-host quantities: the floor needs a margin measured from the unchanged-starter spread on that host, the knee needs an external anchor that has not been sourced, the dichotomizing threshold is a quantile of a reference distribution re-measured there, and the gate pass threshold converts council fractions to booleans and belongs to the council, not to this substrate. Anchors measured on a CPU here bound what the ramp will look like; they are not the ramp
